caption: The drawing depicts three different metal keyhole escutcheons with attached handles, rendered in a combination of pencil and shades of yellow, gold, and gray. Each escutcheon displays a decorative shape and contains a central keyhole, with the metal surfaces shaded to suggest a brass-like material. The top escutcheon is ornate, with rounded, looped elements on either end and an attached ring handle to the left side. The middle escutcheon has a symmetrical design with a bulbous end on the right and left, squared-off cut-out shapes flanking the keyhole, and a curved horizontal handle attached to the left. The lower escutcheon is similar to the middle one in shape but has the curved handle mounted on the right side. There is a small measuring scale marked in inches at the lower right and the name "Hans Korsch" is written at the lower left corner of the paper, which is bordered by a double-lined rectangular frame. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or off-white color.
title: Three Door Handles
